description: A lane in Chur’s old town runs between stone and painted houses toward the Gothic tower of the Martinskirche, with the cathedral hill of the Hof behind the roofs. The street is the historic center of the cantonal capital, free of prominent people and of readable signs. No scaffolding is added. Afternoon light follows the Open-Meteo model for Chur.
